title: Machine learning with transcriptomics nominates DKK1 and S100P in pancreatic cancer
summary: DKK1 and S100P retained stronger diagnostic performance in external datasets, with DKK1 the most robust prognostic marker, alongside single-cell, spatial and functional analyses. The machine learning step is feature selection and clinical use is unproven.
ai_technology: LASSO and SVM-RFE feature selection on transcriptomic data
organization: Shanxi Medical University, Taiyuan, China; Linfen People's Hospital, China

evidence.unknown: Abstract only; ML is feature selection; clinical use unproven; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO and SVM-RFE select DKK1 and S100P as PDAC candidate genes
